overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: no quorum deliberated the public comment policy outside a posted meeting. Authority and public comment restriction claims were not reviewed.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board deliberated outside a posted meeting to create a new public comment policy, since it was never discussed at a meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Furthermore, we find no evidence that a quorum of the Board discussed the policy outside of a meeting and therefore credit the Board’s account of events.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Acting Chair effectively made decisions that should have been made by the Board as a whole when she announced the public comment policy.
Complaint alleged the Board restricts public comment during meetings under the new policy.
allegations.key_passage: The Division of Open Government’s review concerns compliance with the Open Meeting Law; we do not review allegations concerning restrictions on public comment.
